brick_wall_factory.label: brick_wall_factory
brick_wall_factory.description: grid(width, height) of BoxMesh bricks colored sequentially from a named palette — running bond pattern

nail_salon.label: Grand / Petit — Nail Salon
nail_salon.description: A 4.3 metre surreal hand and a petite 32 cm copy share nail and skin colours selected by the existing RGB controllers. A fine manicure table, polish bottles and velvet stools place the contrast at body scale.

catalyst_pedestal.label: Catalyst Pedestal

rainbow.label: rainbow
rainbow.description: Creates double rainbow arcs with atmospheric bloom and layered color bands.

film_rainbow_partitions.label: How many colours fit the same arch?
film_rainbow_partitions.description: Two, six, seven and forty-eight authored bands divide the same width; separated layers join into each arc.

pillarcolorcollection.label: pillarcolorcollection
pillarcolorcollection.description: Named palette columns by default; spatial_gradient maps X/Z to hue/saturation and height to value, with a matching colour ceiling, dark floor, grey reference and pickable RGB/HSV sampler.

film_colour_edge.label: Where does the column end?
film_colour_edge.description: A column rises from dark to light; its matching ceiling arrives and its edge becomes difficult to see.

SpectrumVisualizer.label: SpectrumVisualizer

color_sets_overview.label: Color Sets Overview
color_sets_overview.description: Twelve grabbable palette sets mounted on a framed 6.4 m wall; default presentation remains available.

gridcolorizer.label: gridcolorizer
gridcolorizer.description: Finds cube meshes in the scene and recolors an 11x11 grid to match the rose vase palette.

film_foundation_class.label: One class; whose state changes?
film_foundation_class.description: Two colour receivers read actual RefCounted Palette objects. Separate reference paths converge when both receivers share one instance.

spectrum_forest.label: spectrum_forest
spectrum_forest.description: hue(x) = remap(x, bounds) — 5000 vertical lines colored by x-position across the visible spectrum

albers_wall_gallery.label: albers_wall_gallery
albers_wall_gallery.description: White gallery wall with 98 Josef Albers-inspired canvases and spotlights.

ball_painting_demo.label: ball_painting_demo
ball_painting_demo.description: Shared painting canvas with optional automation. tools:spray replaces pigment balls with grabbable, trigger-operated spray cans and soft grainy deposits; distance, angle and time shape the mark. Other placements retain balls.

rainbow_hallway.label: rainbow_hallway
rainbow_hallway.description: CSG hallway coated with animated rainbow shader controls and glow-rich lighting.

color_constellation_office.label: color_constellation_office
color_constellation_office.description: Color_Walls selects twelve freestanding colour filters, three workstations and a pale open gallery setting; filter/opaque comparison preserves passage. Cubicles and default mixing installation remain separate configurations.

subpixel_display.label: Subpixel Display
subpixel_display.description: Shows how screens create color from RGB subpixels. Three vertical bars (R, G, B) with adjustable intensity via sliders. A combined swatch above shows the mixed color with hex value.

color_space_navigator.label: Color Space Navigator

gradient_interpolator.label: Gradient Interpolator
gradient_interpolator.description: Shows gradient interpolation between two colors using RGB and HSV color spaces. 16 cubes display the gradient. Toggle mode to see how the interpolation path changes between color spaces.

film_gradient_paths.label: The space changes the colours between
film_gradient_paths.description: Source RGB and HSV interpolation take different routes between red and cyan, plotted inside one three-dimensional RGB cube.

colour_assembly.label: Room to gather
colour_assembly.description: Room to gather: an original response after Liam Gillick. Installed application bay in Color_Walls; controls belong to the main museum pointer.

colour_wall_studies.label: Wall relations
colour_wall_studies.description: Wall relations: an original response after Liam Gillick. Installed application bay in Color_Walls; controls belong to the main museum pointer.

pattern_tile_4x4.label: 4x4 Pattern Tile
pattern_tile_4x4.description: Basic 4x4 tile pattern editor. Simple repeat mode.

pattern_architecture.label: Dress the architecture
pattern_architecture.description: Batched skins on actual floor and exposed wall cells of the containing SimGrid. Explicitly selects loom, kaleidoscope, press or mill live output, target, hold, repeat size and tint. Collision and source machines remain independent.

pattern_machine_c.label: Kaleidoscope Mill
pattern_machine_c.description: Dark industrial frame on a bolted plinth: gantry columns, a glowing mill drum with spinning kaleidoscope mirror-wedge rotors, a warp-thread cage with a pulsing weave bar, an editable hopper grid on the head, palette + control button rows, a

pattern_tile_brick.label: Brick Pattern Tile
pattern_tile_brick.description: Tile with brick/half-drop offset. Classic masonry pattern.

pattern_studio_plate.label: Pattern Studio Plate
pattern_studio_plate.description: Full pattern design studio ported from Three.js PatternMaker3D. Cream plate with 4x4 paint grid, 3x3 palette, 6 sliders (motif, group, period, size, zone, site), control buttons, and real-time carpet output using all 17 wallpaper symmetry g

pattern_maker_station.label: Pattern Maker Station
pattern_maker_station.description: Interactive wallpaper group station — paint a domain grid on an upright panel, choose from 17 symmetry groups, and watch the tiled result unfold on a large floor carpet in real time.

film_pattern_symmetry.label: A fragment becomes a pattern
film_pattern_symmetry.description: A source motif unfolds through p4m symmetry; editing one cell changes its distant occurrences.

pattern_machine_a.label: Pattern Machine A — Jacquard Punch-Card Loom
pattern_machine_a.description: Dark machine frame with side posts, top crossbeam, glowing amber warp threads, a pulsing weave bar and feed roller. On the head sits an interactive NxN punch card: touch a peg to toggle it (empty <-> punched color), PUNCH cycles the paint c

pattern_mill.label: Pattern Mill
pattern_mill.description: Dark industrial frame with emissive accents, a glowing core and fold-order mirror rotors, a glowing warp cage, an editable touch-paint head grid, a press head on guide rods + pull lever, and a live wallpaper-group carpet feeding off a chute

drag_catwalk.label: The Floor Is Yours — Drag Catwalk

tiling_demo.label: Tiling System Demo
tiling_demo.description: Italian tiling motifs gallery. 17 wallpaper groups, multi-layer composition. Checkerboard to cosmatesque — field study preparation.

pattern_machine_d.label: Pattern Machine D — Tile-Stamp Press
pattern_machine_d.description: A cast-iron press chassis with side cheeks, a crown beam, an angled editable stamp matrix, a press head on guide rods + a pull lever, ink-well palette buttons, GROUP / PRESS / CLEAR controls, a PatternSim proof sheet on the crown, and a con

pattern_tile_plate.label: Pattern Tile Plate
pattern_tile_plate.description: Dieter Rams-styled pattern studio. Paint a 4x4 grid, see it tile into a carpet using 17 wallpaper symmetry groups. Integrated cream plate with palette, preview, and symmetry controls.

super_drag_mirror.label: Super Drag Looking Glass
super_drag_mirror.description: Full-length camera mirror and a working wardrobe for the player's actual costume. Previous/Next selects Latex Cathedral, Chrome Orchid, Holographic Fan or Pearl Rococo; Walk Dress restores the progression garment. Saves appearance separatel

wall_drawing_291.label: Wall Drawing 291

pattern_tile_puzzle.label: Pattern Tile Puzzle
pattern_tile_puzzle.description: Create patterns on a small tile grid. Watch them repeat across a carpet. Handmade meets computational - from textile traditions to pixel art.

grid_model.label: Grid Model
grid_model.description: Miniature interactive model of the map grid — grab cubes to reshape terrain. Teaches layout_data[z][x] = height as a physical 2D array.

panel_bridge_loom.label: Panel Bridge — Loom Simulator

script_runner.label: Script Runner
script_runner.description: Live code display with real Expression evaluation! Shows code executing line-by-line with actual results. Scripts: #point, #vector_math, #array, #pattern, #loop. Example: script_runner#point:90:1

pulsar_compact.label: Pulsar Compact
pulsar_compact.description: Smaller pulsar visualization. 20 rows of glass tubes.

vr_tile_editor_mirror.label: VR Tile Editor Mirror
vr_tile_editor_mirror.description: VR tile editor starting in kaleidoscope mirror mode. Design symmetric patterns and see them tile across a floor carpet.

facade_grammar_demo.label: Facade Grammar Demo
facade_grammar_demo.description: Architectural facade gallery. Italian presets (Villa San Michele, Certosa, San Gregorio Armeno) plus element library (columns, arches, cornices, rustication).

loom_escher_mirror.label: Loom: Escher (mirror twin-panel)
loom_escher_mirror.description: Mirror-loom weaving a monochrome Escher-palette pattern against its reflection.

pattern_loom.label: Pattern Loom
pattern_loom.description: Dark machine frame with emissive accents, glowing warp threads + a pulsing weave bar, and a wallpaper-textured cloth that scrolls out of the weave line. DNA: group (p1..p6m), palette, motif_seed, loom_style (roller carpet-press / warp tapes

loom_alhambra_p6m.description: Carpet-press loom weaving an Alhambra-palette p6m tiling onto the floor.

wall_pattern_gallery.label: Wall Pattern Gallery
wall_pattern_gallery.description: Overlays wallpaper group shader patterns on grid wall cubes in clusters. Like the catalyst chromatic mode but with all 17 wallpaper groups as GPU shaders.

vr_tile_editor.label: VR Tile Editor
vr_tile_editor.description: VR workspace for designing tile patterns. Edit a grid at desk height, see it tile across a floor carpet in real-time. Cycle wallpaper groups with VR controllers.

mill_persian_p4.label: Mill: Persian p4 (4-fold)
mill_persian_p4.description: Pattern mill milling a Persian-palette p4 tiling — 4-fold rotors, pure rotation.

mill_alhambra_p6m.label: Mill: Alhambra p6m (6-fold)
mill_alhambra_p6m.description: Pattern mill milling an Alhambra-palette p6m tiling — 6-fold mirror rotors.

jacquard_studio.label: Cards become cloth — loom and layers
jacquard_studio.description: Choose stripes, checks, tartan, chevron, herringbone, houndstooth or optical checks with seven physical buttons. Each starts a fresh 96-pick sample. Open its actual yarn geometry with LAYERS or the slider; FLAT closes the same cloth. Clear

mill_escher_p4g.label: Mill: Escher p4g (4-fold)
mill_escher_p4g.description: Pattern mill milling a monochrome Escher-palette p4g tiling — 4-fold off-center rotors.

kaleidoscope.description: A small kaleidoscope on a low stand — a horizontal cylindrical brass-and-steel tube whose axis runs along +X, a smaller dark eyepiece at +X, and a flat disc at -X divided into pattern_segments emissive pie-wedge shards that alternate betwee

thread_loom.label: Follow the Thread — hand loom

pattern_artifact.description: Placeable wallpaper-pattern wrapper. Reads a JSON config (group, motif_seed, palette, tile_size) and renders the resulting pattern as a textured quad facing up — readable as floor tile, banner, or table-top.

tile_meander_floor.label: Tile Meander Floor
tile_meander_floor.description: Greek key meander floor built from exactly 3 tile types: field (solid blue), straight (horizontal key hook), and corner (90-degree turn). Villa San Michele blue majolica style. Each tile is a 7x7 bitmap; when tiled along all 4 borders, they

pattern_atlas_gallery.label: Pattern Atlas Gallery (the makers, named)
pattern_atlas_gallery.description: Twelve world pattern traditions reproduced AS SHADERS (the rule, not an image), each on an upright plate with its makers named beneath: Kente strip-weavers of Ghana, ikat resist-dyers, bingata stencil-dyers of Ryukyu, kanga printers of the

pattern_temple.label: Pattern temple
pattern_temple.description: A Moorish court built from primitives - quads, boxes, cylinders, a hemisphere and a ring - in which every surface is a pattern receiver: floor, far wall, east and west walls, the entrance wall with its corbelled arch, eight columns, the dom

grid_3d_4x4x4.label: 04 / fly inside a 6 x 6 x 6 array
grid_3d_4x4x4.description: Populates a 4x4x4 lattice of pickup cubes for volumetric layouts.

grid3d.description: Universal 3D graph visualization. MultiMesh spheres + cylinder edges. Defaults to BFS. Use #algorithm:<name> to select cartridge.

bar_array.label: BarArray Substrate
bar_array.description: Universal 1D array visualization. MultiMesh bars with emission and smooth transitions. Defaults to Bubble Sort. Use #algorithm:<name> to select cartridge.

bar_array_bubble_sort.label: BarArray — Bubble Sort
bar_array_bubble_sort.description: Bubble sort on a MultiMesh bar array. Adjacent comparisons, largest bubbles to the end. O(n²). The canonical first sort.

sorting_algorithm_race.label: Sorting Algorithm Race
sorting_algorithm_race.description: Four rows of 16 colored bars sort simultaneously using Bubble, Insertion, Selection, and Merge sort. Animated step-by-step so you can watch algorithms race and feel the difference in strategy.

hue_carousel.label: Hue Carousel
hue_carousel.description: A fairground carousel whose canopy is the hue wheel - twelve from_hsv seats at full saturation on the rim, grey-ish seats near the pole, the pole itself the value dimmer. Color taxonomy rung 3, 2026-08-27.

color_mixing.label: Color Mixing
color_mixing.description: Interactive color mixing — combine colors and see the result in different color spaces. Additive (light) vs subtractive (pigment) mixing made visible.

dark_side_prism.label: dark_side_prism
dark_side_prism.description: Snell's law visualized — white beam enters prism, refracts into 7-color fan by wavelength-dependent angle

prism.label: prism
prism.description: Grid-shaded triangular prism mesh for primitive previews.

grab_stick_scanner.label: grab_stick_scannerk
grab_stick_scanner.description: Grabbable stick with a UV-based texture-pixel scanner — samples the hit-point colour from any surface the tip touches, displaying the RGB value live.

two_roads.label: Two Roads
two_roads.description: Two walkable roads between the same teal and orange: the RGB road greys out mid-way (its exact mud held up on a plinth), the HSV road stays saturated round the wheel. A gradient is a choice of path. Color taxonomy rung 8, 2026-08-27.

color_scanner.label: Color Scanner
color_scanner.description: Scans and analyzes color properties of objects and materials. See the numeric values behind what your eyes perceive.

fabric_shader_studio.label: From Source to Skirt — Shader and Fabric Studio
fabric_shader_studio.description: An editable four-by-four source feeds a wall and skirt preview. Inspect UVs, repetition, cut-outs, matte/metal finish and bounded vertex displacement; save/load a recipe, deliberately dress the player or runway performers, and undo applicat

minimalglitch.label: Minimal Glitch

glitchcolor.label: Glitch Color
glitchcolor.description: Color glitch effects — channel shifting, bit corruption, and chromatic aberration. What happens when color data breaks in beautiful ways.

advancedglitch.label: advancedglitch
advancedglitch.description: Interactive colored line visualization and manipulation algorithms

neon_garden.label: Neon Garden
neon_garden.description: Flowers with albedo black and petals of pure emission, breathing on seeded phases under a dark pergola. Emission owes the room nothing. Color taxonomy rung 5, 2026-08-27.

disco_lights.label: disco_lights
disco_lights.description: Interactive colored line visualization and manipulation algorithms

one_bulb_room.label: One Bulb Room
one_bulb_room.description: A dark chamber, six pure-albedo bodies, ONE swinging bulb on a cord (real damped pendulum + OmniLight3D). No light, no color - albedo is a promise light has to keep. Color taxonomy rung 1, 2026-08-27.

laser_turret.label: Laser Turret
laser_turret.description: Standalone laser turret that auto-targets and destroys balls. Place separately from ball_dropper to customize layout. Demonstrates vector subtraction (direction), magnitude (range), normalization (aim), dot product (lock).

synthesis_stand.label: Synthesis Stand

force_play_mass.description: Equal-size PointBody spheres: 1, 2 and 4 kg; a matched one-newton pulse.

force_play_trolley.description: Load the cart and pull its hand grip. A low-friction sliding carrier with decorative wheels.

force_play_puzzle.description: Three weighted cubes, staggered walls and destination marks; push and rearrange.

force_play_vortex.description: Eighteen prefabs move through a visible swirl; the visitor meets the same acceleration field.

wind_room.label: Wind Room (walk-in field)

force_play_liquids.description: Three large transparent drag regions slow falling points and the visitor. Approximate drag and buoyancy, not fluid simulation.

force_play_friction.description: Four slopes compare cube/ball and smooth/rough contact; trajectories leave trails.

force_play_gravity.label: The room lets go
force_play_gravity.description: An entry threshold releases a hinged trapdoor, suspended cargo and a leaning pole.

sentry_turret.description: Half-Life style sentry turret. Targets balls and/or player. Simple reliable targeting with bullet physics. Emits signals for hits.

coin_toss.description: The simplest random experiment. Grab coins from a tray and toss them. A counter tracks the heads/tails ratio converging to 0.5 over many flips. Gold side = heads, silver side = tails.

continuing_die.description: A grabbable physical die adds each settled face to a labelled column. Six permits another throw; a non-six closes the chain. Five throws is a visible display limit, with unfinished chains marked. Separate worked example: 6+6+3.

random_object_spawner.label: Random Object Spawner
random_object_spawner.description: A spawning algorithm that randomly generates and places objects in the environment

random_edge_profile.label: Random Edge Profile
random_edge_profile.description: A planar surface that generates random edge profiles and patterns

Random_Rotate_Random_XYZ.description: Applies random rotation on all three axes (X, Y, Z), creating fully randomized orientations for chaotic arrangements.

random_decay_multimesh.label: Random Decay MultiMesh
random_decay_multimesh.description: Two MultiMesh stacks accumulate bounded drift, rotation, sinking and darkening at different configured rates. Both use fixed one-metre specimen units by default. Optional stack_fit fits both complete displays to a given width with a common

RotateGridCubes.label: Slope Gradient Cubes
RotateGridCubes.description: Gradient slope test with animated rotation for walkability check.

random_walk_collection.label: Random Walk Grab Paper
random_walk_collection.description: Interactive paper that demonstrates random walk algorithms with grab and manipulation capabilities

random_walk_terrarium.label: Random Walk Terrarium
random_walk_terrarium.description: Five random walkers in a reflecting glass tank: fixed-length 2D/3D proposals or bounded inverse-square-root LONG STEP proposals. The legacy LEVY_FLIGHT enum remains compatible. A 200-position tail and optional logbook expose the named seed,

random_walk_leash.label: Random Walk Leash
random_walk_leash.description: A glowing orb on a leash that tugs in random directions. Grab it in VR and feel the random walk through your hand. The orb pulses with each impulse. A trail traces the walk path. Stats track drift vs sqrt(N) theoretical scaling.

random_draw_dot.label: Hand + chance
random_draw_dot.description: The original drawing grip with a visible tip accumulating bounded random steps around the moving hand.

random_position_rails.label: Somewhere to start
random_position_rails.description: Paired rail carriages compare fresh positions with accumulated steps. Shared sampled input, advance targets, matched motor timing and a grabbable prediction marker.

pixel_cloud.label: pixel_cloud
pixel_cloud.description: Builds an upward-biased self-avoiding random walk and places cubes along the path to form a pixel cloud sculpture.

random_walk_128.label: Random Walk 128x128
random_walk_128.description: Fine-grained random walk on 128x128 grid using tiny cubes

distribution_sampler.label: Distribution Sampler

GaussianPaintSplatter.description: Generates paint splatter patterns using Gaussian distribution, creating natural clustering around a center point with density falling off like a bell curve.

galton_board.label: Galton Board
galton_board.description: Balls drop through a triangular peg array. Each peg deflects left or right with equal probability. After many rows, the bin counts form a binomial distribution converging to a Gaussian bell curve. VR buttons: DROP, AUTO, RESET, SPEED.

distribution_comparator.label: Distribution Comparator

bubbles_random.label: Random Bubbles
bubbles_random.description: A particle system that generates random bubble effects with dynamic spawning

mushrooms.label: Mushrooms
mushrooms.description: A procedural arrangement of template copies, noise-filtered candidates, explicit fairy rings and clusters. The optional specimen table exposes SHOW, KIND, SIZE, REGROW and NEW SEED; one seed controls the build and a related seed its ground.

silhouette_arrivals.label: Who arrives?

seeded_room.label: A plan becomes a room

perlin_noise_bridge.label: Perlin Noise Bridge
perlin_noise_bridge.description: Compare seeded uniform heights with FastNoiseLite Perlin samples in two 16×16 grids. Frequency changes the scale of spatial correlation. Both fields use comparable column displays, while their sampling procedures and distributions differ.

env_one.label: Environment One
env_one.description: A procedural environment generation algorithm using randomness for kitbashing

curl_noise_particles.label: Curl Noise Particles

sculpt_one.label: Sculpt One

pollock_painting_in_3d.label: Pollock Painting in 3D
pollock_painting_in_3d.description: Automatic Pollock-inspired painting on a 2D canvas in 3D: sampled marks, a moving stroke cursor, and floor/table/easel/wall supports.

monte_carlo_dartboard.label: Monte Carlo Dart Board
monte_carlo_dartboard.description: Uniform generated points estimate an inscribed circle’s area fraction; four times inside/total estimates pi. THROW, AUTO and RESET expose finite sampling, whose estimate need not improve with every point.

pipe_dream.label: Pipe Dream

extreme_randomness.label: Extreme Randomness

worley_noise.description: Voronoi/cellular noise texture on a floor quad. Scatters random seed points and computes F2-F1 (second-nearest minus nearest distance) for the classic cell boundary look. Complement to Perlin/Simplex noise.

random_space.label: random_space

r_c.description: A cube with fixed state order, random standing/hidden waits and separately switched collision. Optional chasm staging supplies three seeded stones, a recoverable pit, state tablet, REPLAY, NEW SEED and CUE.

random_doors.label: One passage, two fire jets

door_timing_trials.label: When did the door decide?
door_timing_trials.description: Three matched walk-through trials: draw-reveal-choose, choose-draw-reveal, and draw-choose-reveal. Floor plates select a lane; its result opens a direct shortcut or leaves a longer path around a wall. Seeded algorithmic assignment, not phys

box_atrium_space.description: A box-sampled version of the cellular space, with axis-aligned exposed faces, stepped walls and ceilings, level floor and standing-height openings.

shader_10_reactiondiffusion.description: Book of Shaders chapter on reaction-diffusion systems and Turing patterns.

particle_swarm_walk.description: Walk among 24 grabbable PointBodies on a12m score field. See personal and shared best positions. Change the objective while preserving current bodies and motion.

fitness_landscape_politics.label: Fitness Landscape Politics

mst_visualization.label: mst_visualization

evolved_creatures.description: Physics-based creature evolution inspired by Karl Sims — bipedal bodies evolve locomotion through genetic algorithms. Morphology and behavior co-evolve, producing creatures that learn to walk through selection pressure.

non_teleological_evolution.description: Bodies exist in a space with no fitness function. They reproduce based on proximity and energy (gained by exploring, lost by existing). Forms diversify without goal or optimization — just drift, variation, and persistence. No best creature.

kit:sine_yoke.description: Turn the exposed crank by hand. The pin slides horizontally inside the yoke, whose height carries a timber cube on vertical guides. Stop or reverse at any position.

kit:scale_zoetrope.label: Hand wheel / scale zoetrope
kit:scale_zoetrope.description: A five-metre black-steel disk carries 24 fixed off-white cubes with dark outlines at two metres above the floor. Pink crank grips and fader caps mark the touch surfaces. The motor yields to your hand. Starts at 60 RPM and 12 Hz.

kit:triangle_assembly_table.label: TriangleTable / folded edge assembly
kit:triangle_assembly_table.description: Twelve starting movable 3-sided panels. Select a fold from flat, bring two parallel free edges together and release. Lift a face to detach; other faces stay in place. Gold marks a candidate edge. Kinematic joins, not force-simulated glue. Six more faces appear when the loose stock is used; MORE FACES can request them earlier.

kit:square_assembly_table.label: Square faces / folded edge assembly
kit:square_assembly_table.description: Twelve starting movable 4-sided panels. Select a fold from flat, bring two parallel free edges together and release. Lift a face to detach; other faces stay in place. Gold marks a candidate edge. Kinematic joins, not force-simulated glue. Six more faces appear when the loose stock is used; MORE FACES can request them earlier.

kit:single_cube_turntable.label: Hand wheel / one cube turntable
kit:single_cube_turntable.description: Turn a compact 1.10-metre platform carrying one centered off-white cube. Hand input, speed and direction rotate the cube in place with its plate. Black steel, pink grips and the shared machine finish.

kit:torus_piston.label: Wheel / cylinder / torus
kit:torus_piston.description: An exposed finite connecting rod converts wheel rotation into a 1.60 m horizontal stroke. A white cylinder with red bands enters a stationary pink torus. Ideal kinematics, not simulated force or pumping.

kit:pillar_barber_roll.label: Pillar / pink red white barber roll
kit:pillar_barber_roll.description: A pink/red/white helical sleeve physically rotates around a stationary structural pillar. No band moves vertically: a fixed witness makes the apparent climb and real rotation visible.

kit:belt_drive.label: Two wheels / one belt / 2:1
kit:belt_drive.description: Turn either of two unequal wheels linked by a visible open belt. One large-wheel turn produces two small-wheel turns in the same direction. Pink spokes and travelling belt witnesses expose the ratio. Ideal no-slip kinematics, not a force or tension simulation.

kit:matter_spring_and.label: Matter / AND / gravity — earn the reusable assembly
kit:matter_spring_and.description: A one-metre timber slope with a 30cm rise supplies the motion. Lift the pink stop: Jolt simulates the white balls, falling input cubes on slider guides, and a motor-free hinged impact target. No spring launch, prescribed ball velocity or input seating snap. Double working size on a reachable platform.
